question: (a) Obtain the relation between displacement current and rate of change of charge on the plates of a charging parallel plate capacitor. (b) If the charge on the plates changes from $0$ to $6.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ C}$ in $2.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ s}$, calculate the displacement current between the plates.

options.C:
(a) For a parallel plate capacitor, $\Phi_E=EA=\dfrac{q}{\varepsilon_0}$. Hence $I_D=\varepsilon_0\dfrac{d\Phi_E}{dt}=\dfrac{dq}{dt}$.
(b) $I_D=\dfrac{\Delta q}{\Delta t}=\dfrac{6.0\times10^{-6}}{2.0\times10^{-3}}=3.0\times10^{-3}\text{ A}=3.0\text{ mA}$.
